ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled egg-like mass, soft and fluffy with small curds and folds, slightly moist with some sheen, loosely piled on the left side of a white square plate, spreading about 9 cm by 10 cm and roughly 2.5 cm high | 110

ITEM 2 | Round disc-shaped pieces about 2.5 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick, golden-brown to tan with browned edges and a matte, slightly crisp surface, some cut faces showing a uniform pale interior, clustered in a pile on the right side of the plate and covering roughly 35% of the plate surface, stacked up to about 2 cm high | 210

ITEM 3 | Single loose round disc about 2.5 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick, tan-brown with browned edges and matte surface, sitting alone on the plate below the egg mass | 15
